title: RPL DODAG convergence simulator
description:
Simulate RPL network formation from cold start: measure time to stable DODAG, rank propagation, parent selection under varying node densities. Would validate Trickle timer tuning (IMIN=4s, IMAX_DOUBLINGS=8) matches spec claims.

Deliverable: examples/rpl_convergence.py or tests/sim/test_rpl_convergence.py with assertions on convergence time bounds
close_reason: Created tests/sim/test_rpl_convergence.py (590 lines, 22 tests): validates Trickle IMIN=4s, tests star/mesh/linear topologies, 10-200 node scaling
